baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperfect verb at word 1 sets repeated motion around recipients, while words 3-4 identify youthful agents in a lasting condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: A collective of young attendants repeatedly circles a stable recipient-center; lasting youth removes aging and turnover, so the action reads as continuously available service rather than a single pass.

activation_trace.role: Circular motion makes word 1 a recurring route around a recipient-center.
The young-servant branch gives the moving agents youthful human identity and a service role.
Durable, slow-fading stability keeps both their youthful condition and their availability from expiring.

changed_reading.before: Ageless youths move around the recipients.
changed_reading.after: A permanently youthful service corps maintains recurring rounds around a stable recipient-center.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 4 can qualify not only bodily duration but the agents' settled relation to the people encircled by word 1.
baseline_models.mechanism: Circular attendance combines with the staying-and-attachment branch of the modifier: the youths are not merely long-lived but continuously assigned, close, and non-departing in their office.

activation_trace.role: Repeated circling supplies the continuing office to which the agents remain attached.
The youth-or-servant branch identifies a stable attendant class.
Staying, clinging, and close attendance shift permanence from lifespan toward enduring assignment.

changed_reading.before: The modifier states only that the youths do not age.
changed_reading.after: The modifier can also stabilize their relation: they remain continuously attached to the circulating office.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening dismantles an elevated solid mass into fine, dispersed matter. Against that loss of cohesion, the focus combines bounded motion around a center with lasting condition, making the attendants' circuit a local image of order that survives radical dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Bounded circular motion reassembles movement around a center after the opening's outward dispersal.
Lasting stability prevents the focused order from sharing the surrounding dissolution.
Pulverizing and mixing dismantle what had been a coherent mass.
An elevated solid mass supplies the strongest prior image of structure before its loss.
Fine particulate matter supplies the resulting state after structure is broken down.
Scattering supplies unbounded outward motion against which the focus orbit contrasts.

structural_cues: 56:4-6 moves from shaken ground and pulverized mountains to dispersed dust before the ordered garden scene.
The focus replaces unbounded scattering with repeated movement constrained around a center.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solid mass, pulverization, fine matter, dispersal, and later bounded lasting circulation; I infer an anti-dispersal arrow from that sequence. Alternatively, the opening collapse may only establish the eschatological setting and may not directly qualify the attendants.

changed_reading.before: Their permanence is a static promise of agelessness.
changed_reading.after: Their lasting circular motion also images a restored order that neither fragments nor disperses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recipients occupy stable, tightly made supports and face one another. Their stationary reciprocal geometry turns the focus verb into choreographed circulation around or through the perimeter, allowing service without breaking their mutual orientation.

activation_trace.role: A settled place of support fixes the recipients spatially while attendants remain mobile.
Tight interweaving makes the seating field ordered and structurally coherent.
Reclining and reliance keep the recipients at rest rather than participating in the circulation.
Face-to-face orientation establishes a reciprocal interior that the service route must preserve.
Circling becomes the mobile perimeter around the recipients' fixed facing arrangement.

structural_cues: 56:15-16 grammatically presents the recipients as reclining and mutually facing immediately before the active verb of 56:17.
The alternation of stationary recipients and moving attendants creates complementary spatial roles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed supports, reclining, mutual facing, and circular motion; I infer that the route runs around or between the seated group so their facing is preserved. A live alternative is simple repeated approach from several directions without a geometrically closed route.

changed_reading.before: The youths move near a group of recipients.
changed_reading.after: Their route is spatially choreographed around a stable face-to-face assembly, preserving its reciprocal center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following vessels are the moving agents' payload, the flowing source is supply, and recipient choice and desire are demand. The focus motion therefore becomes a replenishing delivery loop whose goods reach each person while harmful aftereffects are excluded.

activation_trace.role: Repeated circulation supplies the transport path linking source, vessels, and recipients.
The young-servant branch supplies the human carriers who execute the loop.
A portable open cup supplies one class of carried container.
A cup understood with its contents makes delivery of drink, not empty display, the payload.
A flowing water source supplies the replenishment point for repeated rounds.
The headache branch supplies an adverse outcome that the delivered drink explicitly does not produce.
Selection makes the supply responsive to the recipients rather than uniform.
Desire makes the next delivered good recipient-driven.

structural_cues: 56:18 is syntactically dependent on the circulating agents and supplies what they carry.
The branchless ن ز ف occurrence at 56:19 is used only as a structural negation of depletion or intoxication.
56:20-21 moves from available goods to what recipients select and desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circulation, vessels, a source, absent harm, selection, and desire; I infer the operational arrows source -> carrier -> recipient -> renewed request. The live alternative is abundant presentation without individualized fetching or replenishment.

changed_reading.before: The youths circulate decoratively while provisions happen to be nearby.
changed_reading.after: Their circulation is a demand-responsive delivery loop carrying replenished goods to each recipient without adverse effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit correspondence between prior action and recompense converts the attendants' repeated work from background luxury into the active administration of reward: the promised return is continually delivered as an experienced service.

activation_trace.role: Recurring circulation makes recompense an ongoing process rather than a static possession.
The attendant identity supplies the agents through whom the return is concretely experienced.
Reciprocal recompense frames the preceding service scene as an answer to prior deeds.
The wage-or-return branch ties the experienced provision to purposeful work.

structural_cues: 56:24 follows the inventory of service and provisions with an explicit recompense clause.
The focus verb is active and iterative, allowing reward to be rendered as something administered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated service followed by recompense for work; I infer that the service is one mechanism by which recompense is enacted. Alternatively, 56:24 may summarize the entire garden scene without assigning a special administrative role to the attendants.

changed_reading.before: The attendants are decorative evidence that reward exists.
changed_reading.after: Their recurring service is reward in operation, continually administering the return attached to prior work.

context_deltas.mechanism: Circulating attendants introduce constant motion into a communal setting, yet the closing auditory field excludes mixed noise and limits voiced content to repeated peace. Their rounds can therefore be read as socially frictionless movement that does not disturb the assembly.

activation_trace.role: Continuous movement supplies the potential disturbance that the later auditory constraints neutralize.
Auditory perception defines the channel in which the scene's social effect is measured.
Mixed clamor supplies the kind of ambient noise explicitly absent from the setting.
Voiced speech supplies the sole positive auditory event that follows the exclusions.
Freedom from harm gives the repeated utterance its environmental function: preserving peace.

structural_cues: 56:25-26 closes the service-and-provision sequence by regulating what is heard.
Repeated peace replaces both idle clamor and accusatory speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mobile attendance followed by an auditory exclusion and repeated peace; I infer that the circulation participates in, or at least does not disrupt, that peaceful field. A live alternative is that the auditory rule concerns only the recipients' speech and says nothing about the attendants' manner.

changed_reading.before: The verse specifies movement but leaves its social texture unstated.
changed_reading.after: The attendants' rounds are frictionless circulation within an acoustic order where motion produces no clamor and peace remains the only voiced content.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary surface reading favors agelessness, but the focus inventory explicitly permits word 4 to mark ear or hand adornment, while the nearby pearl and protective-cover branches sharpen a preserved visual register. Retain it as a secondary ornamental reading, not as evidence against bodily permanence, because the pearl comparison may grammatically concern a different group.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4 directly modifies the youthful agents, and its focus-root inventory contains an adornment-specific branch.

activation_trace.role: Movement makes attached adornment repeatedly visible as the attendants pass.
The youthful attendant branch identifies the figures who bear the visual marker.
The adornment-specific branch permits the modifier to mark enduring ear or hand jewelry rather than only duration.
Pearl supplies a nearby precious-material analogy for conspicuous ornament.
Protective covering supplies the quality of preserved, unworn appearance.

changed_reading.before: Word 4 means only that the attendants remain forever young.
changed_reading.after: Word 4 may additionally present the passing youths as permanently adorned, their motion displaying a preserved visual splendor.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the following vessels strongly favor service, but the focus motion inventory contains both patrol and fortified-perimeter branches, and the attachment branch of word 4 can keep such agents at their post. Protection and safety cues make a custodial overlay coherent; render it only as exploratory security imagery, never as a replacement for the delivery reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb at word 1 can lexically activate a circling watch, while word 4 can mark continued attachment to that station.

activation_trace.role: The circulating-watch branch turns repeated movement into custodial patrol.
The fortified-boundary branch gives the patrol a protective perimeter around the recipients.
The young-servant branch keeps the custodial agents anchored in the verse's actual subject.
Staying and attachment make the patrol continuously stationed rather than occasional.
Protective shielding supplies an environmental cue for a guarded interior.
Protective concealment reinforces the idea of an interior kept intact.
Freedom from harm supplies the condition that a custodial circuit would preserve.

changed_reading.before: The moving youths are exclusively bearers of provisions.
changed_reading.after: Their service rounds may carry a secondary custodial image: a permanently staffed protective circuit around the assembly.

strongest_changes: Opening dissolution turns enduring circular motion into a local image of order that does not disperse.
Facing repose and following vessels convert generic motion into a choreographed, demand-responsive delivery circuit.
Reward and peace clauses make the circuit enacted recompense whose movement does not disturb the social or auditory field.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse became a systems hinge: mobile attendants connect stable seating, replenished supply, recipient choice, noninjurious enjoyment, and peaceful social texture, while lexical side branches preserve ornamental and custodial possibilities.
remaining_uncertainties: Word 4 may primarily mark ageless bodily condition; attachment and adornment remain secondary branch activations.
The facing arrangement does not specify the attendants' exact route, so a closed perimeter is inferred rather than stated.
The auditory constraints are not grammatically assigned to the attendants, and the custodial reading remains branch-distant.
